capabilities: Transcribe PDFs and images to Markdown via Google Gemini
Transcribe Canvas files locally without an API key
Filter which files are transcribed with glob patterns
Customize the Gemini prompt and output template for transcripts
Place transcripts in a configurable folder and clean up orphans when attachments are deleted
disambiguation: Not an attachment manager; it generates Markdown transcripts of PDF, image, and Canvas attachments using AI.
extras: Only Google Gemini is supported as the AI provider. The Gemini free tier has a daily request cap, so a large vault may take days to fully process on first run. Includes a companion agent skill for transcribing files with the plugin's settings. The plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian stores PDFs, images, and Canvas files as binary attachments whose contents cannot be searched or read as notes.

relations.evidence: PDFs and images are processed by Google Gemini.

summary: AI-powered transcriber that converts PDFs, images, and Canvas files in a vault into searchable Markdown notes using Google Gemini.
